name: Alex Morgan
bio: Specializing in AI automation, software workflows, and emerging developer tools for modern remote teams.
description: Alex Morgan is a veteran software journalist and tech editor with over 8 years of experience covering developer tooling, cloud infrastructure, and artificial intelligence. He works closely with engineering teams to analyze productivity trends, AI-driven automation, and open-source tools that empower remote workforce efficiency.

name: Sophia Chen
bio: Advising enterprise companies and global distributed teams on async communication, culture, and remote performance.
description: Sophia Chen is a remote work researcher and organizational culture consultant. Having managed distributed teams across 4 continents, Sophia writes actionable guides on asynchronous collaboration, remote onboarding frameworks, and mental wellness for digital nomads.

name: Marcus Vance
bio: Exploring cross-border taxation, global banking, offshore compliance, and digital nomad residency programs.
description: Marcus Vance is a global tax consultant and financial journalist based in Lisbon. He helps freelancers, solopreneurs, and digital nomads navigate international tax treaties, multi-currency banking solutions, and visa programs across Europe and Southeast Asia.

name: Elena Rostova
bio: Helping independent creators, copywriters, and designers scale client retainers and build high-ticket freelance practices.
description: Elena Rostova is a seasoned freelance business coach and creative director. She has empowered over 500 independent professionals to escape low-paying marketplaces, master cold outreach, structure high-ticket retainer contracts, and build resilient personal brands.

name: David Miller
bio: Founding editor at Freebirds Digest, passionate about distributed work ecosystems and future of employment.
description: David Miller is the Editor-in-Chief and founder of Freebirds Digest. With a background in investigative journalism and tech publishing, David curates high-impact news, industry reports, and in-depth analytical pieces for remote professionals worldwide.
